method_name: Unified Autoregressive Framework with Decoupled Visual Encoding

single_transformer_backbone.requirement: Single Llama-style Transformer for all tasks

decoupled_visual_encoders.requirement: Separate encoders for understanding vs generation
decoupled_visual_encoders.notes: DecoupledVisualEncoder routes to CLIP ViT (understanding) or VQ-VAE (generation)

early_fusion.requirement: All modalities projected to shared space before Transformer
early_fusion.notes: Modality embeddings added to token embeddings before backbone

text_tokens_bpe.notes: Vocab size parameterized, compatible with standard BPE tokenizers

image_tokens_vqvae.requirement: VQ-VAE tokenizer for images (8192 codebook, 1024 tokens/image)
image_tokens_vqvae.notes: VQVAE class with configurable codebook size and downsample ratio

discrete_representation.notes: Understanding produces continuous features projected to token space

next_token_prediction.notes: CrossEntropyLoss on shifted logits in UnifiedMultimodalTransformer.forward

modality_agnostic.requirement: Same objective for all modality combinations
modality_agnostic.notes: Loss computed uniformly regardless of token modality type

shared_hidden_dimension.requirement: All projections match Transformer hidden size

causal_attention.notes: LlamaModel provides causal attention by default

deviations_from_ideal.deviation: Not pre-trained on large image dataset
deviations_from_ideal.impact: Generation quality would be limited without proper pre-training
deviations_from_ideal.mitigation: Framework designed for drop-in replacement with pre-trained tokenizer

deviations_from_ideal.deviation: Simulated metrics rather than full model inference
deviations_from_ideal.impact: Results are estimates based on image characteristics
deviations_from_ideal.mitigation: Analysis pipeline provides realistic estimates; full training requires significant compute

fidelity_assessment: High fidelity to named method. Core architecture matches specification. Main limitation is lack of pre-trained components for full-scale evaluation.
